117603.name: Chabad of the Space & Treasure Coasts
117603.note: Its own timeline: 'When it all began 25 years ago... November 1990'; 'Chabad's first location at 750 Palm Drive'; 'Chabad Opens a Storefront Location, 1993'; 'Construction begins at the Chabad Jewish Community Center, 1998' (now 1190 Highway A1A, Satellite Beach). Lubavitch.com: Rabbi Zvi and Shulamit Konikov were newly appointed to Brevard County in 1990. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N41903.json): CHABAD OF THE SPACE COAST, INC. (document N41903), filed 02/01/1991; president Zvi Konikov; agrees with its November 1990 start.

117594.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Fort Lauderdale
117594.note: Rabbi Moishe Meir and Penina Lipszyc 'moved to Fort Lauderdale in 1990 to establish a Chabad center' (Chabad.org); the City of Fort Lauderdale's 'Chabad Drive' renaming (2024) dates it to 1990; one profile says the Rebbe sent them in 1989. On the Galt Mile (NE 35th Street, now Chabad Drive). Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N42424.json): CHABAD LUBAVITCH OF FORT LAUDERDALE, INC. (document N42424), filed 03/06/1991; president Rabbi Moishe M. Lipszyc; agrees with 1990.

117590.name: Chabad of Miami
117590.note: Its own site: 'Serving Miami's Jewish Community since 1989', Rabbi Yakov and Gutal Fellig its founders. Chabad.org: co-director of Chabad of South Dade in Miami since 1989. Bet Ovadia, 3713 Main Highway, Coconut Grove. (therebbesimpact.com's 1975 for the couple is not the center's year.) Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N31168.json): CHABAD OF MIAMI AND SOUTH DADE INC. (document N31168), filed 03/13/1989; Yakov Fellig, 3713 Main Highway; agrees with 1989 (also THE LUBAVITCH FOUNDATION OF SOUTH DADE, INC., N45680, filed 10/18/1991).

117593.name: Chabad of Pinellas County
117593.note: Its own site: Chabad of Pinellas County (Young Israel-Chabad) was established in 1988; Rabbi Shalom and Chanie Adler have directed it for more than 20 years, 'first in Clearwater, and now at 3696 Fisher Road in Palm Harbor'; their son Rabbi Pinchas Adler leads it now. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N27941.json): CHABAD OF PINELLAS COUNTY, INC. (document N27941), filed 08/15/1988; agrees with 1988.

117597.name: Chabad of Greater Orlando
117597.note: Heritage Florida Jewish News (COLlive, 1 Jan 2010): 'This year, Chabad of Greater Orlando will celebrate 25 years of service in Orlando. Since its inception in 1985'; the Dubovs 'were chosen as ambassadors ... shortly after they wed in September 1984'. Heritage (2019): established in 1985. Its own site says 'founded in 1984' (the year of the appointment). Began in a small storefront. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N14270.json): CHABAD-LUBAVITCH OF GREATER ORLANDO, INC. (document N14270), filed 04/08/1986; Rabbi Sholom Dubov; a year after its 1985 start, which stands.

118475.name: Chabad of Coral Springs
118475.note: Anash ('Chabad of Coral Springs celebrates 36 years and counting'): 'Established in 1986, Chabad of Coral Springs began when Rabbi Yossi Denburg and his wife Rivka were sent to South Florida' to build a Hebrew day school and a Chabad House; Rabbi Avraham Friedman became executive director in 1991. (Coral Springs Talk counted its 36th anniversary in 2023, and therebbesimpact.com says 1987: a year later.) Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N17897.json): THE CHABAD LUBAVITCH COMMUNITY CENTER, INC. (document N17897), filed 11/21/1986; 3925 N. University Dr, Coral Springs; agrees with 1986.

117595.name: Chabad of South Broward
117595.note: COLlive (Illuminations series): Rabbi Raphael and Goldie Tennenhaus began Chabad's work in South Broward in December 1980, first holding services in a small shul on Wiley Street; the first Chabad House in Broward County. Anash: 'Chabad of South Broward celebrates 45 years' (2025). Now 1295 E. Hallandale Beach Blvd. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N13360.json): CHABAD OF SOUTH BROWARD, INC. (document N13360), filed 02/10/1986; Raphael Tennenhaus; later than its December 1980 start, which stands.

earlier.where: a small shul on Wiley Street

117903.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Southwest Florida
117903.note: Rabbi Yitzchok Minkowicz 'arrived in Southwest Florida in 1992' (WGCU/press profiles); COLlive: the Minkowiczes asked Rabbi Korf for a place in Florida without shluchim, were sent to Fort Myers and 'opened a small Chabad house in a central location'. Its later building (5620 Winkler Road) was dedicated with $3.5 million (CrownHeights.info). Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N47907.json): CHABAD LUBAVITCH OF SOUTHWEST FLORIDA, INC. (document N47907), filed 03/17/1992; Rabbi Yitzchok Minkowicz, 5620 Winkler Road; agrees with 1992.

earlier.where: a small Chabad house in a central location, Fort Myers

117591.name: Chabad of Parkland - Regional HQ for North Broward & South Palm Beach
117591.note: The Coastal Star: the Bistons came to Miami in 1973 and worked in Aventura, Fort Lauderdale and Boca Raton 'before founding Chabad of Parkland in 1998'. Parkland Talk (1 Oct 2019, its new building opening for Rosh Hashanah 5780): 'They have been moving around Parkland for 20 years, beginning at The Winners Circle, then a storefront on 441 and Loxahatchee', then a small building on the present property. Rabbi Yosef Biston had founded the Chabad Center of Margate in 1985. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N42067.json): CHABAD LUBAVITCH OF NORTH BROWARD AND PALM BEACH COUNTIES, INC. (document N42067), filed 02/13/1991; Joseph and Bayla Biston, now 7170 Loxahatchee Rd, Parkland: the regional body is older than the Parkland center, whose 1998 stands.

earlier.where: a storefront at US 441 and Loxahatchee Road
a small building on the present property

2301323.name: Beis Menachem
2301323.note: Its own home page: 'The Community Shul Since 1989'; 'For over 35 years, Bais Menachem has stood as a cornerstone of the Chabad-Lubavitch community in Miami Beach'. Mikvah.org (news item now removed; from the search index) agrees: it 'was established in 1989, when the Chabad community in the 41st Street area of Miami Beach had grown sufficiently in size to require its own shul', with Rabbi Yehuda Leib Schapiro as rav. Now at 444 West 40th Street. therebbesimpact.com says 1987. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/N19797.json): CHABAD HOUSE OF MIAMI BEACH, INC. (document N19797), filed 03/24/1987; directors Yehudah L. Schapiro, Tsiffion Cohen and Avrohom Brodie, dissolved 10/13/1989: perhaps where therebbesimpact.com's 1987 comes from, but not shown to be this shul, whose own 1989 stands.

120123.name: Lubavitch Educational Center
120123.note: Its About page: 'Our school was established by the Lubavitcher Rebbe in 1966 and opened with just seven children' (its home page says 1967). Chabad.org's obituary of Rabbi Avraham Korf (17 July 2025): 'The following year [after 1965], Rabbi Korf founded what was then called the Oholei Torah day school' in Miami Beach, which grew into the Lubavitch Educational Center. Now at 17330 NW 7th Ave, Miami Gardens. Sunbiz (record page opened Nov 10: work/founding-years/sunbiz/entities/746008.json): LUBAVITCH EDUCATIONAL CENTER, INC. (document 746008), filed 02/15/1979; three lay officers at 1680 Michigan Ave, Miami Beach, dissolved 12/08/1980: later than the school's 1966 start, which stands.

earlier.where: Miami Beach (as the Oholei Torah day school)
